taxonomy.name: Food
taxonomy.description: Purchased food for human consumption, including kinds without a listed child. Classify the purchased kind regardless of buyer intent.

taxonomy.name: Housewares
taxonomy.description: Purchased reusable household utensils and textiles, including kinds without a listed child. Classify the purchased kind regardless of intended recipient or use.

taxonomy.name: Services
taxonomy.description: Purchased passenger travel or repair labor only. Other services fall outside this taxonomy.

taxonomy.name: Passenger travel
taxonomy.description: Purchased bus, rail, or ferry rides for a passenger.

taxonomy.name: Repairs
taxonomy.description: Purchased labor to repair an existing physical object.
